title: A Vercel AI SDK provider joins the developer tools list
summary:
The developer tools directory now points Vercel AI SDK users to a community provider for text, images, and speech.

@artsiombarouski’s Pollinations provider was added to the Dev_Tools directory and README app list. It supports text, image, and speech generation through the Vercel AI SDK.

highlights.title: Pollinations for Vercel AI SDK
highlights.text: Find @artsiombarouski’s Pollinations provider in the developer tools directory. It supports text, image, and speech generation through the Vercel AI SDK.
